    "text": "#320 isolated Nihang / crowd correction

Director320 rejects319 supporting cast appearance and performance. S3 request
cancelled; no upload occurred. Work only on leader/rear and crowd clearance,
including exactly24 frames before and after the core shots. Preserve complete
masters; no full trailer render. Core frames276–417; review252–441 at24fps
(7.9167s). Actual camera cuts and clearance completion must confirm this range.

## Outcome and floor

Leader and near warriors must share the Pashtun's believable cloth, accessories,
anatomy and response language at their actual framing. They need not acquire
hero facial-closeup resources, but cannot remain primitive caricatures. The
leader recognizes and acknowledges the rider; the crowd responds as individuals
to his permission, making room deliberately rather than shuffling in unison.
Horse plants, gathers, drives upward, briefly suspends, then strikes and absorbs
the landing. No floaty deceleration before impact.

## Strategy / motion brief

1. Audit current geometry, contact and action ownership; bind the319 rejection
   as the negative control and accepted Pashtun appearance as the film floor.
2. Replace repeated lateral step-close with individually timed turn-and-walk
   paths, world-planted feet and pelvis transfer; head leads torso, arms/props
   follow the body with restraint. Preserve corridor and bike clearance.
   Director clarification: attention remains on the rider throughout clearance;
   do not turn faces away and walk off. Limit body yaw to retain comfortable
   head tracking, and verify gaze in the actual outgoing framing.
   Native08 close coverage exposed a crouched gait: .90m total leg links exceeded
   the .785m rest hip/ankle distance. Recalibrate to .80m, use shorter steps,
   and solve pelvis support for both feet before either leg. Retain08 as a
   negative control; reuse leader frames only after unchanged-object and image
   controls establish that the crowd-only correction does not affect them.
3. Retain horse rig/topology, replace descent/preparation timing (not a global
   speedup). Momentum persists until hoof contact; compression/recovery follow
   contact. Rider hips stay saddle-owned, torso balances, neck/head attend the
   protagonist, elbows accommodate rein/spear grips. No random independent sway.
4. Improve one leader and one near warrior's cloth envelope, draped fold shapes,
   seam/edge construction, surface wear and metal/leather contrast first. Then
   propagate bounded variants. Texture noise cannot repair primitive forms.
5. Render inexpensive representative frames, then contiguous isolated motion.
   Inspect all source frames, close contacts, reference timing and preserved
   boundaries. Use source-time mapping for affected sound, not a silent impact.
   Only after no known frame-visible blocker, finish the isolated review clip.

| Beat | Coordinated performance / highest risks | Early proof |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Incoming1s | Preserve greeting/camera/music; no pop into new actor | Both boundary frames and neighbouring motion |
| Leader anticipation | Gaze to rider, head/torso response, hands supported; horse gather overlaps lift | Side silhouette, hand/cloth joints, hoof height/speed samples |
| Rear and impact | Hips follow saddle; torso/head compensate differently, elbows yield; descent accelerates into impact before compression | Every rear frame, contact trajectories, head/chest relative transforms, sound event anchor |
| Crowd clears | Different reaction lags, modest torso turns, short diagonal steps; faces continue tracking rider rather than walking away | Foot support, gaze direction and path clearance through outgoing handle |
| Outgoing1s | Settlement and attention continue as rider advances | Complete context handle, no action truncation |

All methods are local shot-authored approximations, not full human/animal physics.
Use existing licensed sources; no new installation/provider/spend/upload. Camera,
principal proxy, bike, scenery, music and Pashtun are protected. Internal method
reassessment has no arbitrary elapsed-time cutoff. Repeated surface patches or
contact regressions trigger representation reassessment. Direct AV judgment is
Director313's; absence of agent playback cannot excuse visible source/frame
failures.319's anatomical/contact checks did not establish convincing acting.

## Applied learnings and exit

AU reference/deformation/performance/contact/material/reuse,271 same-film floor,
319 semantic axes/frozen normals/contact ownership/dense sampling,249 shot lenses
and0004 coordinated motion apply. New torso motion invalidates old cuff and neck
proofs: rebind every dependent garment/prop instead of inheriting319 PASS.
Preserve failed versions and exact recipes. Report job/work time separately from
Director idle, unknown tokens honestly. No initial claim of a percentage saving.

Return one complete isolated candidate with handles and concise changes, or a
real method/authority blocker. Not another diagnosis-only handoff. Director judges
performance and same-film believability. Successful scope unlocks reintegration
without rerendering unrelated shots, then principal Sikh construction.
"

# Expert-lens planning: derivation, proof and original-intent review

Adopted and implemented locally at Director exchange328. Goal: extract more
value from creative direction and reduce avoidable technical corrections, not
reduce useful Director choices or lower the quality floor.

## What changed

The previous shot brief contained good manual guidance, but the staged controller
did not require its application. A valid brief could contain two generic checks
and a strategy paragraph. It now rejects that production brief.

For each trusted beat intent the planner must assess story/performance,
camera/editorial, animation/physics, anatomy/contact, effects/environment,
sound/music and production/reuse. These are perspectives, not seven workers.
Additional specialties belong in the relevant derivations. Every applied lens
must produce concrete linked requirements; non-application needs a reason.

Each requirement records its derivation, method, coupled interfaces, early proof
at intended framing, observable failure, reopening trigger, priority, origin
(Director/reference/craft inference) and reference IDs. Reference roles and
fidelity contracts remain mandatory in all stages. Exact approved identities
and faithful motion references are not interchangeable with directional images.

Before admission the planning stage challenges intent coverage, interdisciplinary
conflicts, omitted failures and scope tradeoffs. The trusted parent reads this
challenge and seals its hash. This is **not an independent fourth expert** or a
claim that hashing verifies reasoning. Unresolved issues block admission. Routine
in-scope methods do not need a Director approval; material creative/authority
conflicts do. Lightweight retrieval/display/link tasks retain their separate route.

Execution records how every requirement was applied against the same plan digest.
This is traceability, not visual proof. Review receives original intent and
references, not just a checklist or the builder's success narrative. It must scan
for omitted requirements and report per-beat intent observations. An intent FAIL

# Series 01 — C-led art direction

Draft v0.1, exchange 75, 2026-09-17. Director authorized development of the brief after reaffirming C. The rules below are proposals for review, not blanket approval or completion of A5.

## Adopted production principle — larger than life

Director248 explicitly adopts **larger than life** across The Martials: character presence, music, dramatic shots and beats, pacing and the complete audience experience. It is also a stated personal Director preference, not merely a Pashtun-entrance effect. This adopted principle governs compatible proposals below; it does not retrospectively approve every draft detail.

Aim for heightened, memorable cinema rather than an adequate depiction of events: strong silhouettes and composed presence; decisive character-specific action; impactful scale and camera reveals; a musical hook with tension, swagger and exhilarating release; tactile, weighty sound; visually rich authored surfaces. Preserve the illustrated-C language rather than pursuing uncertain imitation of live action. Physical weight, readable motivation, cultural specificity and recognizable humanity remain the foundation.

Contrast is essential. Not every beat is faster, every sound louder or every expression larger. The Pashtun's composed assessment makes her explosive route choice stronger; the Sikh's mounted stillness can carry power without copying her gallop; the Gurkha's care for another person can make his ferocity more affecting. Do not convert the three into interchangeable action poses or caricatures. No additional powers, violence, assets, spending or fixed choreography are authorized by this principle.

Internal review must name the signature moment, its preparation and payoff, what makes it extraordinary at normal viewing size, and what would break its credibility. Review music, performance, composition, sound and pacing together. The rule should appear in each new sequence's audience brief, not be applied as a late generic spectacle filter.

## Exchanges199–200 — integrated rider performance and painted costume/skin

199: Director likes198's terrain direction but identifies rigid neck performance, overly pronounced neck/clavicle relief, awkward thumb/rein contact and a bleached face. Requests thoughts first; no native edit in that discussion. Recommendation: isolate deformation versus illumination, preserve accepted neutral anatomy, repair actual hand contact, then one coordinated richer indigo/warm leather/skin treatment rather than blanket darkening or new skin noise.200 authorizes this complete recommendation and explicitly forbids an intermediate neck/grip handover. Phone delivery remains parked; no upload authorized.

**Outcome/quality floor:** one complete six-second moving comparison on198 terrain, with skilled but yielding riding attention, believable exposed neck and rein grip, richer indigo fold masses and dark worn brown boots, and retained warm textured identity. Original pair B supplies colour/mark intent; accepted152 native remains neutral identity/anatomy authority. No final studio/release qualification or universal rig claim.

**Strategy/interfaces:** pin198 scene/cache inputs → inspect actual bone/mesh/material ownership and matched close/side anatomy and hand controls → correct the demonstrated motion/deformation/contact cause in a derivative → transport or renew affected shawl support only when measured change warrants it → coordinated material derivative retaining authored maps → cheap matched wide/close/control proof → full chronological motion and independent reopen → integrated comparison. Do not resculpt accepted neutral anatomy to compensate for light. Do not inherit cloth/contact acceptance after changing its supports. Preserve camera, terrain, horse, tail, accepted hair/face topology, blink and existing edit clock. Failed controls remain evidence, not replacement targets.

**Motion brief:** composed experienced rider maintaining forward attention through repeated loading/unloading, not a locked portrait or wobbling head. Source gait217–360 at24fps supplies phase; chest drives delayed distributed neck/head absorption while eyes continue attending forward. Preserve pelvis/feet and arm endpoint path unless actual hand-contact evidence requires a local correction. Fingers/thumb must form one supported hold around the rein; rein follows the evaluated hand channel, not a guessed endpoint. Quantify both local articulation and world motion without treating amplitude as naturalness. No new human reference footage is claimed. Inspect full-speed actual-camera and fixed-view cycle, shoulders/clavicles/jaw/hair/shawl, both grips, and endpoints for jumps.

**Early falsifiable proof:** matched original/derivative closeup and a complete fixed-view gait cycle must visibly reduce bracing without introducing a rubber neck, collarbone erasure, jaw/cloth collisions or wandering gaze. Clay and unchanged-light controls distinguish geometry from shading. Thumb controls must change the actual rendered thumb without hand collapse or rein crossing. If adjacent repairs regress repeatedly, reassess representation before additional variants. Darker cloth must retain legible two-wrap construction and blue highlights; face must retain existing texture rather than orange tint, airbrushing or noise.

**Resources/reuse/exit:** one heavy Blender worker, existing trusted closed operations and local dependencies, no new paid calls/tools/assets/publication. Forecast under2GB incremental native/cache/frame evidence for one coherent candidate, revise with observed need. No arbitrary elapsed-time stop; prospective ledger capture, unknown token/cost and historical gaps remain explicit. Preserve source-bound parameters, selected native and evidence for18-second integration. One final integrated handover after internal visual and technical gates, or an exact Director-owned blocker. Checkpoint200 is due at completion; accepted release gates remain1/25, not a time/progress estimate.

### 200 result — integrated rider and painted costume/skin review

[Six-second integrated clip](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-entrance200/entrance-v200.mp4), [source/media manifest](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-entrance200/manifest.json), [internal visual review](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-entrance200/visual-review.json), [operating card](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-entrance200/operating-card.json). Review-ready, not Director acceptance or final-resolution production qualification. The matched comparison includes198 versus200 close reveal, costume and grip; no intermediate neck-only handover.

Selected native `entrance200-seal17/scene.blend`, SHA256 `0c898747a695db3e59ba8d8a9676961f306f91873c5f050e35d61f00d1a0623f`. Distributed lagged head/neck response and a pose-driven neck corrective reduce bracing and exaggerated relief; accepted neutral geometry has0.0 new-corrective displacement. Actual index-chain contact targets replace the hooked thumbs. Deeper indigo shawl, dark worn brown boots and richer skin retain authored maps; no new skin-noise layer or identity resculpt. All unrelated rig matrices remain unchanged in the measured build. A bounded transport updates the affected headfall cache; this is not a universal cloth solver or new full simulation.

Internal review covers all144 chronological frames, the24-frame fixed-view gait cycle, matched clay/lit neck, both grips and full-size final-camera controls. The complete432×768/24fps silent clip fully decodes; final naturalness/look acceptance remains Director-owned. Independent19 reopen passes geometry/object/action/camera-light fingerprints,48 cache samples with0.0 error, seven rig-pose samples with maximum1.222e-6 and four particle checks with maximum9.289e-5 native error.38 focused tests and comparison-control state tests pass; browser-layout screening is NOT_RUN.

# Proposed serial planning substages

Status: response to Director329, proposed, not implemented or independently
qualified. Existing328 content gates remain active. No new inference allowance,
model dispatch, render or construction is authorized by this proposal.

## Objective

Reduce the chance that retrieval, expert derivation, creative alignment, technical
strategy and self-review compete within one large planning response. Determinism
enforces sequencing, required inputs/outputs, freshness and admission; reasoning
still determines applicability, taste, causality and method quality.

Keep three outer phases: PLAN, EXECUTE, REVIEW. For substantial production work,
PLAN becomes four serial steps with persisted artifacts and explicit exit gates:

1. **Ground the task.** Assemble original direction and beat intent; relevant
   historical learnings; movie identity/style/theme; Director preferences; source
   references and roles; accepted/rejected controls; constraints/authority.
   Separate these sections rather than flatten into prose. Each relevant item
   names its source, status, scope and expected implication. Missing coverage or
   unresolved authority blocks; unknown preferences remain hypotheses, not fact.
2. **Derive the creative/technical requirements.** Select and apply relevant
   expert perspectives per beat, grounded in step1. Predict audience understanding,
   feeling, dramatic carriers, believability hazards and interdependencies. Output
   derived requirements and tradeoffs, not construction code. Every contextual
   obligation is applied or explicitly out of scope with rationale.
3. **Design the execution strategy.** Resolve cross-discipline conflicts; choose
   representation/methods, interfaces, dependency order, reuse, earliest integrated
   proof, resource envelope, failure/replan tests and final evidence. Output one
   executable work package, not several independent specialists' wish lists.
4. **Challenge and admit.** A fresh review context compares original direction,
   authoritative grounding, derived requirements and proposed strategy. Seek
   missing expert lenses, ignored learnings, same-film mismatch, weak methods,
   expensive invisible work and unsupported assumptions. Outcome: admit, route a

# Nihang rearing and supporting character review failure

Director exchange321, 2026-10-20. **Candidate320/10 is Director rejected. Its recommendation for review is withdrawn.** Technical successes remain technical history; no scene or animation changes are made by this audit. The current request is comparison and process diagnosis before more construction.

The main failure is not missing instructions. The320 strategy and retrieved packet already required convincing whole-body performance and the accepted Pashtun's visible quality. Execution improved local mechanics, while review substituted attachment, nonzero movement and improvement over319 for those outcomes. The313 human audiovisual review stage then became too broad an escape route for unresolved appearance and pose failures.

## Evidence and limits

- Reference: `.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh256/references/reference-b.mov`, SHA256 `78d0d691e8712c02931876cf0bc405e4869de357f337f531708be7a7da4898e2`. Inspected freshly extracted action samples from14–19s at10 samples/second, including the full source frame and cropped action. Nominal timestamps have approximately0.1s sampling precision. This is an edited visual reference, not motion capture or a verified physical timing standard. Embedded social-media text is not production direction.
- Rejected delivery: `.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh320/delivery-10/nihang-crowd-review.mp4`, SHA256 `ad7d980eb064a03837989f27d68ebacfe08576cb30625f92696c20b5fc50d452`. Source frames252–441 at24fps; leader coverage276–356. Candidate frame times in the audit are `(frame-252)/24` relative to this isolated clip.
- Candidate evidence: full-size298/321/350/400, chronological300–323, phase controls276–356, stored all-frame hoof/head trajectories, and the actual construction code. The accepted Pashtun20s frame at4.5s supplies a production appearance comparator. Different lights/cameras preclude attributing every difference to material alone; broad form and construction failures are nevertheless plainly visible.
- [Phase comparison](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh321/comparisons/phase-comparison.jpg), [appearance comparison](../../.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh321/comparisons/appearance.jpg), and [evidence provenance](../../results/sikh321/evidence.json). Phase pairs are functional correspondences, not identical camera projections or a synchronized retiming prescription.

This is a frame-sequence/source/trajectory audit, **not a claim of direct real-time video or audio perception**. Director feedback establishes the full-speed rejection. Visible shape and material defects do not require that missing capability to reject them. No new auditory verdict is offered.

## Reference comparison

| Action | Reference evidence | Candidate evidence and deficiency |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spear cue and preparation | Around15.1–16.3s the cue leads into a conspicuous head/neck curl and changing forefoot placement. The body looks gathered rather than merely waiting for lift. | Frames286–310 contain spear and foot changes, but the horse's neck remains a comparatively long, shallow-changing column. The torso/quarters do not develop a comparably compact silhouette. Separate foot gestures do not visibly load the whole animal. |
| Drive upward | Around16.4–16.9s the chest rises out of the gathered shape; hind-leg bend, body pitch, tucked forelegs and head position change together. | Frames310–321 are dominated by raising/pitching the body over supported hind feet. At321 the hind legs appear long and nearly straight while the chest has rotated upward. This is a major source of the mechanical impression, not a missing noise layer. |
| Foreleg silhouette | Reference16.8–17.5s has compact, curved folding with changing hoof orientation and unequal limb presentation. | Candidate318–338 presents prominent angular elbows/carpi and long hanging distal legs, with a strongly paired outline. Adding a small left/right time delay has not produced the required articulated silhouette. Exact joint/axis diagnosis requires a rig control; the visible failure is already sufficient to reject. |
| Neck and head | Reference16.0–18.3s changes the arch, poll/head angle and silhouette through gather, effort and landing. | Candidate head/neck keys are nonzero, but the elevated shape remains column-like and the muzzle projects from it with little apparent yielding. The question was incorrectly reduced to whether the head moves relative to the neck. |
| Crest | Reference17.0–17.8s remains an active balance, with changing limb/body/head relationships rather than a single rigid pose held aloft. | Candidate321–338 varies, but within a narrow, stiff shape family: extended support below, angular forelegs above, upright neck. A slightly shorter hold cannot fix the pose family. The audit does not establish an exact excessive-hold duration. |
| Descent and contact | Around18.0–18.4s forelegs reach, body comes through contact and head/mane/tail/rider follow; earth spray makes the contact legible. | Candidate344–356 reaches the ground faster than its predecessor, but quickly returns to almost the same upright standing assembly. The impact lacks a comparably readable compression and follow-through across the whole animal and rider. Existing debris does not supply missing body weight. |
| Rider | The reference rider is comparatively restrained, but remains part of the horse's balance through seat, leg, upper-body, arm and rein relationships. |320 adds relative torso/head and supported leg movement. The resulting standing and airborne frames still read as a posed figure carried on a saddle. Motion existence and correct endpoints are weaker tests than visible bracing, yielding and recovery. More arbitrary sway would be another wrong fix. |

The airborne portion is of roughly similar order in the two samples: approximately1.7s in the reference versus approximately1.6s from candidate310 to349. These are coarse visual event brackets, not exact timing measurements. They argue **against treating the complaint as simply a global speed problem**. Pose design, distribution of acceleration, overlap and contact response matter more than adding frames or speeding the whole shot.

The stored candidate trajectory makes the limitation concrete. Left-front toe vertical speed is approximately4.23m/s downward over347–348 and reaches its supported height at349. The tracked head height then changes only about0.018m over349–356, mostly returning upward toward rest. That is not a complete absorption measurement, but it corroborates the frame-visible weak recovery. A passing fast-toe-arrival check cannot establish a forceful whole-body landing.

## Appearance failures

These are visible at intended framing, not demands for hero-level microscopic detail.

# Planning substage implementation and qualification

Director330 authorizes critique, implementation and tests of329. Local code,
source-bound records, offline fixtures and known-history replay only. No new
runtime inference allowance, render, provider, installation, upload or artistic
admission. Preserve253 and321. Three outer phases remain; planning is serial.

## Critique before construction

1. Decomposition can become a paperwork pipeline. Each artifact must change the
   next stage's constraints; the controller must reject dropped obligations,
   unsupported sources and skipped stages. Named lenses are not application.
2. Summaries can launder authority or omit the Director's actual intent. Every
   stage retains original direction and reference-role contracts, source IDs,
   status and scope. Hypotheses cannot silently become approved preferences.
3. Retrieval is incomplete. Require a source/relationship reconciliation and
   explicit gaps beside the fresh pilot packet. Missing catalog entries are not
   evidence of irrelevance. Do not rebuild a universal graph for this pass.
4. A rigid waterfall can entrench an unsuitable method. Challenge must return a
   specific failure to grounding, derivation or strategy. Failed output may expose
   planning omissions too. Reuse only unaffected upstream artifacts; invalidate
   downstream evidence. Corrections share one persisted package allowance.
5. Self-review can repeat the author's conviction. Separate the challenge's
   dispatch/input from strategy authorship, omit self-admission prose, retain
   original sources and require observations/counterexamples. Fresh context is
   not independent expertise or a proven perceptual judge.
6. Prior321 had many correct requirements already. The method must explain why
   it should work, its evidence status, alternatives and earliest representative
   falsification. No amount of plan validation substitutes for actual pose/frame
   evidence and Director-owned full-speed/audio review.
7. Extra stages increase calls/context and create new failure surfaces. Use
   bounded stage packets, serial execution, durable events, idempotence and
   existing call/resource leases. Lightweight workflows bypass production
   planning explicitly; no agent per lens. Never manufacture savings percentages.
8. Early proof must precede expensive commitment. Strategy requires an ordered
